page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 12 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and network-based resources. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU performance of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. In memory bandwidth testing, the instance registers 1282.13 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 109.43 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, and 48.03 GB/sec for large-block writes. Cryptographic and compression capabilities are demonstrated by a PassMark CPU encryption score of 10664.23 and a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 25.08 GB/sec.

The ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, and database operations. It achieves a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec and handles 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second. For lightweight machine learning, it processes 135M parameter LLM prompts at 1294.61 tokens/sec, though performance drops to 34.44 tokens/sec for 7B parameter models. The dedicated CPU allocation provides stable performance without resource contention, offering a balanced resource density for enterprise applications that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
